description.value: You were originally built for security or defense, and as a result, combat has been etched into your circuits from the very beginning. Perhaps you were a soldier built as a disposable vanguard in a conflict that had nothing to do with you, a bodyguard assigned to protect your wealthy owner to the end, or the loyal sniper bot of a deadly assassin. Regardless of origin or present outlook, you're a dangerous enemy to have. You gain one of the following general feats of your choice: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Armor Proficiency] or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Weapon Proficiency].
